_comment: Model assignments for framework (Anthropic OAuth + OpenAI direct API only). Roles mirror the upstream oh-my-openagent defaults (see dist/index.js), upgraded to the newest models each provider currently exposes via `opencode models`. Rationale: Opus orchestrates/plans (sisyphus, prometheus, metis), the newest GPT reasoner debugs and critiques (oracle, momus, hephaestus, atlas), Sonnet drives the cheap-and-cheerful parallel sub-agents (sisyphus-junior, explore, librarian, frontend, document-writer, multimodal). NOTE: the plugin auto-upgrades a few legacy ids at load (claude-opus-4-5 -> 4-6, claude-sonnet-4-5 -> 4-6, gpt-5.3-codex -> gpt-5.4), so avoid gpt-5.3-codex here or it silently becomes a non-codex model.
